name: Tsujira Miyako
source:
A second year student.

 The protagonist's childhood friend and ex-girlfriend.
 She's come to Tonosawa, where the protagonist lives, to spend her summer holidays. She's caring and has a gentle nature.
They've also shown a surprising aptitude for magic and has ended up helping the protagonist with his rehabilitation.   (And she has massive G-cup breasts!!)
